name.zh: Bosworthia 藻体片段教学标本

description.en: Preserved Bosworthia-inspired thallus fragment, displayed as shallow-thickness ribbon branches. No whole parent organism, roots or unknown attachment reconstructed. Nominal span and color are artistic.
description.zh: Bosworthia启发的保存藻体片段，以浅厚度柔带分枝展示。不重建完整母体、根或未知固着结构；名义跨度及配色属美术选择。

author: Leon Made This / s010s

artistic_choices.en: Nominal dimensions, original palette, exact repeated-feature counts and static pose are artistic. No strict species, specimen-copy, locomotion, animation or coexistence reconstruction.
artistic_choices.zh: 名义尺度、原创配色、重复结构数量及静态姿态属美术选择。不作严格种级复原、标本复制、运动机制、动画或共存复原承诺。

nominal_scale.kind: nominal art-direction choice, not a newly measured fossil dimension; display scaling separately labeled

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
